title: Give OLY-B-S2-01 a complete prompt-surface inventory mechanism
summary: Retry of rejected job 20261030-033242-et3s: add a reproducible prompt-surface inventory in the study crate that covers every surface of a studied instance (cited or not), record it as OLY-B-S2-01's mechanism with owner Athena and a `status: not shown` measure, and test it against an independent list.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria require running the test against real studies/ data and an independent list, not just existence.
fmt, clippy and test criteria included.
Coverage compared with an independent list with negative cases.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal and audience: the Athena owner and the verifier must be able to see, per studied instance, every file or text that instructs an agent, and re-run that analysis from code.

Previous job 20261030-033242-et3s findings addressed: (major) cited-only proxy is replaced by a definition of prompt surface (agent-instruction conventions: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .claude/, skills, prompt/brief templates, role files, defaults, and briefs rendered inside scripts) applied to the whole pinned tree when mounted and to every path or script the study data mentions, cited or not; ordinary .md docs are not prompts unless the study marks them; (minor) the empty-inventory negative case calls a shared per-instance check helper on an empty result; (minor) test placement and the shard-timings change are now deliverables; (nit) changelog and mechanism text say 'every prompt surface'.

Code survey: read crates/athena-cap-study/src/lib.rs, rules.rs (MountedTree and the pinned-source/ mount at about line 1838-1848) and the file list of crates/athena-cap-study. The pinned-source/ directory is absent from the repo top level, so the real-data run cannot rely on it; the entry point is a pure function over a study directory plus an optional tree. The studies/ dir holds one instance, studies/firstmate-work-handling, with claims.json, rationales.json, findings.json, model.json, intro.json, pin.json, validation.json. No new record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file/AnyRecord/round-trip tests are unaffected.

Existing code: crates/athena-cap-study/src/rules.rs (MountedTree, pinned-source mount) and crates/athena-cap-study/src/model.rs are reused for reading a study's pinned tree and records; docs/spec.toml holds the OLY-B-S2-01 entry (currently mechanism "none", measure 'The spec gap list; status: requirement').

The file crates/athena-core/tests/prompt_inventory.rs named in the earlier job's deliverables does not exist and is not created; athena-core cannot depend on the study crate, so the test goes in crates/athena-cap-study/tests/prompt_inventory.rs, which this change creates.

Independent list: a fixture in the test, written by hand from reading the study's claims.json, rationales.json and findings.json text (including surfaces mentioned but not cited as evidence, such as bin/fm-spawn.sh which claim c3 says renders a brief), plus a small sample tree built in a temp directory with known surfaces. The inventory must be a superset of this list; the list is not produced by the inventory code.
Measure text will be: names `cargo test -p athena-cap-study --test prompt_inventory` and ends `status: not shown`.
Consumers: none found for docs/spec.toml changes beyond the existing spec-gap tests; xtask/shard-timings.txt is registered per repo convention for the new test file.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml entry OLY-B-S2-01 has a mechanism that is not "none" and cites crates/athena-cap-study/src/prompts_inventory.rs and crates/athena-cap-study/tests/prompt_inventory.rs, owner "Athena", and a measure that names the test command and ends with `status: not shown`; the mechanism text says 'every prompt surface'.

crates/athena-cap-study/src/prompts_inventory.rs defines a pure, sorted, deterministic inventory that names no instance id, defines prompt surface by agent-instruction conventions (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .claude/, skills, prompt/brief templates, role files, defaults, briefs rendered in scripts), does not list ordinary .md docs as prompts unless a study marks them, and includes surfaces the study mentions without citing; crates/athena-cap-study/src/lib.rs declares the module.

Run `cargo test -p athena-cap-study --test prompt_inventory`: the test runs the inventory twice over every real studies/<id>/ directory and asserts identical non-empty output, and asserts the output contains every entry of the hand-written independent list for studies/firstmate-work-handling, including an uncited surface such as bin/fm-spawn.sh.

The same test file has negative cases that run and pass by asserting failure of the shared check helper: a spec entry with mechanism "none", an empty inventory passed to the per-instance helper, and an inventory with a known uncited surface removed. A sample-tree test shows a non-instruction .md is excluded and an uncited AGENTS.md is included.

`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` each pass, as run by the verifier or recorded by Athena on the final tree (D115), including the existing spec-gap and record round-trip tests.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the change saying the inventory covers every prompt surface of a studied instance; xtask/shard-timings.txt registers the new test file.

out_of_scope: Studying new instances or editing existing studies/ data
Editing docs/decisions.md entries or anything under records/
Creating crates/athena-core/tests/prompt_inventory.rs (the test lives in the study crate instead)
Adding a pinned-source/ tree to the repository
departures: Slightly lower verification pass odds and higher cost than reference: the previous attempt failed on completeness and the independent-list test is harder to get right.
